the word "custodial" doesn't exist in my dictionary, but "retail" does. it's a noun and means that the item is free to sell again.
the word "retail" is also not a noun, it's also an adjective.
the word "custodial" is a noun meaning, the item is kept for use and is not released or sold.
the word "retail" is an adjective meaning, the item is kept for future sale and is not permanently taken from the seller.
there are many more terms that can be used to describe the distinction.
